scope: Capability-driven local post-processing and delivery control/responsibility boundaries

implementation.recipe_freeze: DRAFT recipe versions receive an immutable recipe hash; publish retires the prior ACTIVE version and execution requires a fresh plan hash
implementation.failure_boundary: Each local FFmpeg step records input/output SHA-256; failed runs are marked FAILED, clean temporary output, and never register or overwrite the source MediaVersion
implementation.control_versions: BrandKit, WatermarkProfile and CompliancePolicy are immutable project versions; delivery snapshots the selected ACTIVE IDs/version numbers and machine findings
implementation.responsibility_boundary: Machine preflight remains PASS/FAIL while HUMAN and PLATFORM decisions are separate required fields and delivery events; corrupt or withdrawn packages cannot be reviewed

negative_path_added.case: tampered delivery package is rejected for HUMAN/PLATFORM review until rebuilt
negative_path_added.assertion: machine preflight PASS does not authorize review of a CORRUPT artifact

required: real local font/watermark and control version rotation

notes: Automated local FFmpeg/API regression covers implementation and negative boundaries; formal production UAT and release closure remain outstanding.
